tasks.title: Search Google Images for artist/genre artwork
tasks.task: Add a right-click option on artist and genre cards to search for artwork online. It opens Google Image results for the name; selecting an image sets it as that artist's/genre's artwork (same override as 'Set artist/genre artwork…'). Google blocks non-browser requests, so results are shown in an embedded WebView2 browser.

requirements.text: Artist and genre right-click menus have a 'Search artwork online…' option
It shows Google Image results for the name
Selecting an image sets it as that artist/genre's artwork

notes.text: Implemented and released in v1.0.41 but not yet exercised against live Google results (headless Chrome gets a CAPTCHA; the in-app browser is interactive). Waiting on the user to try it: right-click an artist/genre > Search artwork online..., pick an image, confirm the card art changes.

tasks.title: Unsync played or locally removed podcast episodes from iPod
tasks.task: Update iPod podcast synchronization so episodes are removed from the device when they are marked played in Sink or when their downloaded file has been deleted from the PC. Apply the reconciliation when an iPod is connected and on the next sync after local state changes. Preserve unplayed episodes that still have a local download and do not disturb unrelated music or podcast data.

requirements.text: Episodes already marked played when the iPod connects, and episodes marked played before a later sync, are excluded from the desired iPod podcast set and removed from the device.
Episodes whose local downloaded file was deleted are excluded from the desired iPod podcast set and removed from the device on the next sync.
Unplayed episodes with an available local download and unrelated iPod media remain intact.
The behavior is covered by focused verification and the application builds successfully.

tasks.title: Deezer downloads lose album covers and are MP3s re-wrapped as FLAC

Earlier builds hid the missing cover by overwriting it with the artist photo (Danny Gonzalez: all singles show the Slime cover, downloaded 2026-09-28 before the v1.0.44 fix).

requirements.text: Non-MP3 targets download Deezer's real FLAC (quality 2)
The album's own cover survives any format conversion

tasks.title: Diagnosed Streamrip Deezer CDN 403
tasks.task: Patched StreamripToolManager to update dead e-cdns-proxy to new cdnt-stream.dzcdn.net endpoints. Confirmed the 403 Forbidden error is a widespread streamrip issue with Deezer's new DRM. Fixed a compilation error regarding TryDeleteDirectory.

tasks.title: Fix streamrip link.deezer.com/s short URLs
tasks.task: Patched Streamrip's URL parser to support the new link.deezer.com/s/ dynamic short URLs that Deezer is now generating.

tasks.title: Fix streamrip 403 Forbidden by changing default quality to MP3
tasks.task: Changed Sink's default streamrip quality from 2 (FLAC) to 1 (320kbps MP3) to bypass Deezer's strict DRM which blocks FLAC downloads on free ARLs with a 403 Forbidden error.

tasks.title: Fix partial search on Deezer
tasks.task: Removed strict advanced search field filters from Deezer API query so partial terms and album compilations can be properly resolved by Deezer's global search engine.

tasks.title: Fix over-aggressive album search page opening
tasks.task: Changed the score threshold to require an exact match (score 100) and ensured track field is empty before showing the album page view, otherwise providing a generic catalog of matching albums.

tasks.title: Fix API limits truncating relevant search results
tasks.task: Increased Deezer API limit from 16 to 50 to ensure heavily covered compilations (like Punk Goes Pop) don't get paginated out of the initial results, and increased Sink's UI limit from 20 to 50 albums.

tasks.title: Add kind filters and extract artist/album from track results
tasks.task: Added toggles for Artist, Album, and Track to filter the UI. Modified SearchDeezerTracksAsync to synthesize Artist and Album results from the track payload so they show up in generic searches.

tasks.title: Fix missing albums in Punk Goes search
tasks.task: Increased Deezer API limits from 50 to 100, and sorted the generic lists locally by AlbumMatchScore to ensure precise matches float to the top of the paginated results.

tasks.title: Advanced catalog sorting algorithm
tasks.task: Renamed AlbumMatchScore to CalculateMatchScore. Created unified list of all catalog items and sorted them globally using points: 1000 for exact, 900 for StartsWith, 800 for EndsWith, 700 for Contains, and words-matched for the rest. Secondary sort applied to Enum.Kind for Artist -> Album -> Track preference.

tasks.title: Score injection for parent entities of exact matches
tasks.task: Added an internal MatchBonus field to MusicSearchResult to artificially boost synthesized artists and albums. Searching a track exactly will give its Artist 1100 pts and Album 1050 pts. Searching an album exactly gives its synthesized Artist 1100 pts. This perfectly ensures Artists/Albums correctly float above exact tracks when doing track-level searches.

tasks.title: Fix global search vs isolated field query matching
tasks.task: Updated CalculateMatchScore to accept distinct strings for track, album, and artist boxes instead of combining them into one blob and counting matched words. If a search result matches exactly the field you requested, it scores 1000 base points. Then the fuzzy word count is added on top. This ensures 'Graduation' by 'Kanye West' correctly scores 1002, matching exactly Album and 2 fuzzy words, popping it right up to the top. Also added a GridSplitter to make the sidebar resizable, and bound the Sidebar width and download settings to AppSettings to save state between sessions.

tasks.title: Add scoring breakdown logging
tasks.task: Added extremely detailed score accumulation logging to CalculateMatchScore. When a search is run, every scored match logs a detailed breakdown of how it accumulated points (e.g., [Score] Album | Kanye West | Graduation => 1902 [AlbumTitle Exact (+1000), ArtistName StartsWith (+900), Words x2 (+2)]) to the application log file so the user can see exactly why items are ordered the way they are.

tasks.title: Add multi-service music search to Downloads
tasks.task: Add a search box to the Downloads page that searches Spotify, YouTube, and Deezer. Show each result with Download, YT, Spotify, and Deezer actions. Download should choose the best available source in priority order Deezer, Spotify, then YouTube. Adding a result queues its link while allowing continued searching or returning to Downloads to start the queue. Selecting a result shows artwork and metadata in a lower details editor; users may override all populated metadata except track titles before queueing.

requirements.text: The Downloads page can search Spotify, YouTube, and Deezer and display unified results.
Each result exposes Download, YT, Spotify, and Deezer actions; Download prefers Deezer, then Spotify, then YouTube.
Adding a result queues its chosen link without forcing downloads to start and the user can continue searching or return to the Downloads queue.
Selecting a result shows artwork and metadata below; all populated metadata except track titles can be overridden before queueing.
The completed change is verified, committed, built as a release, and published as a GitHub release.

tasks.title: Polish Downloads and link-search UI
tasks.task: Clean up the Downloads page so its hierarchy, spacing, actions, queue status, and empty/loading/error states are easier to scan. Give special attention to the recently added link and catalog search experience: make the entry points and modes obvious, keep primary actions visible, and retain all current queueing and metadata-editing behavior.

requirements.text: The Downloads page has a clearer visual hierarchy with consistent spacing, grouped controls, readable status, and deliberate empty/loading/error states.
Link entry and multi-service catalog search are clearly distinguished and easy to operate with mouse and keyboard.
Queueing, provider actions, metadata editing, resizing, and persisted settings continue to work without layout regressions.
The application builds successfully after the UI changes.

tasks.title: Audit and improve app performance
tasks.task: Sweep the full application for avoidable UI-thread work, unbounded concurrency, repeated I/O, excessive refreshes or logging, and other likely causes of system-wide stalls. Prioritize Downloads and Podcasts, which can make the computer hang while active, then address additional high-confidence hot spots elsewhere without changing user-visible behavior.

requirements.text: Downloads avoids unbounded or UI-thread-heavy work; concurrency and progress/log update rates are bounded where appropriate.
Podcast refresh, download, persistence, and view-update paths avoid redundant I/O and long-running work on the UI thread.
The rest of the app is reviewed and additional high-confidence performance issues found during the sweep are fixed or documented as follow-up tasks.
Findings and implemented optimizations are documented on the card, and the application builds successfully.

notes.text: Performance sweep findings and changes: Downloads now virtualizes/recycles queue containers, throttles yt-dlp UI progress to about 8 updates/second or meaningful 1% changes, serializes progressive TagLib/artwork imports, avoids rebuilding the hidden library after every finalized track, and removes per-candidate synchronous score logging. Podcasts now serializes large file downloads, serializes auto-rule passes and iPod replacement work, coalesces overlapping feed refreshes, batches persistence and view refreshes for bulk/automatic downloads, throttles transfer progress, and virtualizes/recycles episode and search rows. Whole-app fixes move drag/drop music import off the UI thread and debounce library search rerenders. Review also covered iPod reads/writes, artwork work, Streamrip, notification/Reflect views, persistence, maintenance actions, and library grouping. Larger layout/thread-safety refactors are captured as locked follow-ups #241 (virtualized library card grids) and #242 (background-safe Settings maintenance). Verification: Release build succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors; no test project is present.

Final Debug build succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

The application builds successfully in Debug configuration.

Explicitly set #F4F6FA on the Download title, dynamic Music/iPod ViewTitle, and dynamic PodcastTitle. Debug build succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

tasks.title: Run library maintenance without blocking the UI
tasks.task: Move Refresh library and Organize library disk/tag scans out of the WPF dispatcher while safely applying model changes on the UI thread and showing busy/progress feedback in Settings.

requirements.text: Refresh and organize operations keep the window responsive during large library scans.
Track property and collection updates remain UI-thread-safe and persistence remains correct.
Settings prevents duplicate maintenance runs and reports completion or failure clearly.

notes.text: Moved refresh tag scans and organize disk work to background tasks using detached Track snapshots. WPF-bound model changes are applied on the UI thread, persistence serializes background-safe snapshots, and Settings prevents overlapping maintenance while showing progress plus completion or failure feedback. Verified with a focused organize/missing-file smoke test and a Debug build with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

tasks.title: Detect fake (upconverted) FLAC files

tasks.title: Keep high quality setting (FLAC originals)

tasks.title: Download high quality from right-click
tasks.task: Albums, artists, genres and tracks get 'Download high quality'. With Keep high quality on: fake-FLAC originals are deleted and replaced, MP3/lossy tracks get a real FLAC downloaded to the high-quality folder, genuine FLAC is skipped. With it off: the track is re-downloaded in the chosen format and the old file deleted and replaced, unless it's already that format (and not a fake FLAC). Existing tracks are updated in place, keeping plays, playlists and favorites.

requirements.text: Right-click Download high quality on albums, artists, genres and tracks
Keep-high-quality rules (replace fake, fetch FLAC for lossy, skip genuine)
